items.title: Steve Davis interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, December 15, 2017
items.q: So they played with Maynard together.

ctx.x: Oh yeah. I’m sure they will. Mike Dubaniewicz is a really cool cat. He played with Maynard and played with my good buddy Kris Jensen, who I grew up with in Binghamton, a great tenor player, not as well known as he should be in the jazz world,

but anybody who knows him knows he can really play. So they played with Maynard together. Oh I could go on and on. There’s a lot of great musicians who don’t — as you know — who really don’t get their due or appreciated enough. But you can’t do it for that. It’s a way of life. And you certainly can’t do it to get rich. But you do it because you love it and I wouldn’t trade it for the world, being a jazz musician. I wouldn’t trade it for the world.
All right. That’s a good note to end on.
